'''Super buzz droids''' were oversized [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|Pistoeka sabotage droids]] equipped with laser cannons either side of the main body. The outer casings, green on standard buzz droids, were colored red on Super Buzz Droids. They were designed to attack larger ships rather than [[starfighter]]s. Super Buzz Droids rarely saw action, but they were known to be used during the attack on the [[Battle on the Sedawan|Sedawan]]. The only known ship to have Super Buzz Droids in it's arsenal was the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|Subjugator-class]] heavy cruiser, the [[Devastation]].
